notes: Chart agreed across both layers already (all seven rows Fizz, matching the packet), so no side/win edits were needed. Two packet suspectNames are false positives: 'Bait Scatter the Weak' and 'Use Unleashed Power' are the correct Riot names, flagged only because of the leading verb. Six report[] entries were edited, above the two-per-matchup sweep cap, but every one was a lint-flagged MISGENDER and the edits are pronoun-only — no prose was rewritten there. Kit numbers used: Dark Sphere 7s flat / 800 range, Force of Will 12/11/10/9/8 / 925 / true damage via Transcendent, Scatter the Weak 15s flat / 650, Unleashed Power 120/100/80 / 675 with a Splinter execute.
